a: services define containers; networks and volumes connect them.
Use .env for local variables; do not commit secrets.
depends_on with condition: service_healthy waits for readiness.
docker-compose.override.yml customizes local dev without editing base.
Profiles enable optional services (e.g. debug tools).
build.args pass build-time variables into Dockerfiles.
Named volumes persist data across container recreation.
docker compose logs -f service tails logs.
Scale stateless services with docker compose up --scale.
Compose is great for dev; production often needs orchestrators.
